source_start: immediately before real start_stream after RAPTOR activation and neural hover; origin is earlier internal capture, not current body position
source_current_set: actual startup-observation center; lateral position offset +/- .01m and lateral q offset +/- .1; all other coordinates at recorded center; source-quantized members included
nonempty_source_image: actual recorded center from named local-position/attitude samples is a nonempty source observation; nearby finite lateral perturbations are source-allowed inputs, with future dynamics conditional on residual interface
proxy_initial_buffer: empty. At k<22 delayed index max(0,k-22) repeats the earliest acquired sample. Equivalent 47-state lift fills slots from FIRST actual e/d, not fictional body history
lift_first_sample: all delay slots filled from first actual generated reference and declared body state, same two lateral generators; no fictional history
initial_residual_P_radius: 1e-9 for exact initial frame/subtraction representation; independently checked
model_error_condition: all unresolved GRU/action/motor/estimator/height effects enter current p,v,q residual; NOT assumed zero. A2 w_P<=1e-7 is tested against old data separately
prestream_physical_reachability: recorded center exists; no assertion that every perturbed member is produced by the closed-loop controller or satisfies w<=1e-7
